# ADR-3024: A02: Documented field-level encryption scope for PII class 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Not all fields need application-level encryption.

## Decision

Products MAY adopt a documented field-level encryption scope for PII class 12 (A02-12) when regulation demands it.

## Consequences

Key access is separated from data access roles.
